# SD18 deterministic Human Fighter level 15 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic Human Fighter pilot from the bounded
# level 14 (seventh bonus feat, bravery +4) tranche to level 15 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam and the
# deterministic Longsword / Chain Shirt / no-shield posture. Level 15 is NOT
# a bonus-feat cadence level (1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, ...) and NOT a
# weapon-training rank-rise level (rank stays 3; the next rise is level 17),
# so this fixture adds no new bonus-feat or weapon-training-group choice --
# it is identical to the level-14 fixture except for the class level itself.
